11025|8faa4e47.name: Mukdrak
11025|8faa4e47.text: I know a few things. You want me to show you?

11025|f03c89ad.name: Mukdrak
11025|f03c89ad.text: You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

230317|c605ad7f.name: Mokvar
230317|c605ad7f.text: Thrall has shown great kindness in granting me sanctuary within his domain.  I do not wish to overstay my welcome, at any rate.  It would be a great dishonor if I brought any trouble to our leader.

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our $r gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature
